metadata.title: Robo-AO Kepler Survey V: The effect of physically associated stellar companions on planetary systems

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's "unbound" nearby stars are assessed as unbound from their KOI primaries, not unbound from the Milky Way (e.g., T:p3-b7, T:p4-b1, T:p6-b5). It identifies no star as a Galactic unbound candidate, and no star is studied as a previously identified Galactic unbound candidate.
